photos.file: Formica fusca ants in threat display.jpg
photos.desc: Formica fusca ants (local name: "solom") reacting to a camera flash by threateningly aiming their gaster in front of their bodies, ready to squirt formic acid.
Formica fusca , the common black ant of Europe, is a palaearctic ant with a range extending from Portugal in the west to Japan in the east and from Italy in the south to Fennoscandia in the north.
